# UIDragDetector

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UIDragDetector")`

Lets the player drag its parent with the pointer: a window by its title bar, the thumb of a slider or a dial. A press on the parent or anything inside it, followed by a movement, drags it, with a mouse or a finger. A press with no movement is still an ordinary press.

`DragStyle` sets how the object moves, and `ResponseStyle` sets what is changed. The detector sets the parent's `Position` or `Rotation`, so it cannot move a parent that a layout arranges.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BoundingUI` | `UIObject?` | — | read/write | An object the dragged object must stay inside. With nil there is no bound. |
| `DragAxis` | `Vector2` | `Vector2.new(1, 0)` | read/write | The direction a `TranslateLine` drag moves along, with Y pointing down. `(1, 0)` is horizontal and `(0, 1)` is vertical. |
| `DragRotation` | `number` | — | read-only | How far the current `Rotate` drag has turned the object from where it began, in degrees. |
| `DragStyle` | `Enum.UIDragDetectorDragStyle` | `Enum.UIDragDetectorDragStyle.TranslatePlane` | read/write | How the pointer's movement is turned into the object's movement. |
| `DragUDim2` | `UDim2` | — | read-only | How far the current drag has moved the object from where it began, in the terms `ResponseStyle` uses. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether a press can start a drag. |
| `MaxDragAngle` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The upper limit on how far a `Rotate` drag can turn the object, in degrees. It is not applied while it equals `MinDragAngle`. |
| `MaxDragTranslation` | `UDim2` | `UDim2.new()` | read/write | The upper limit on how far the object can be moved from where the drag began. It is not applied while it equals `MinDragTranslation`. |
| `MinDragAngle` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The lower limit on how far a `Rotate` drag can turn the object, in degrees. It is not applied while it equals `MaxDragAngle`. |
| `MinDragTranslation` | `UDim2` | `UDim2.new()` | read/write | The lower limit on how far the object can be moved from where the drag began. It is not applied while it equals `MaxDragTranslation`, as it does by default. |
| `ResponseStyle` | `Enum.UIDragDetectorResponseStyle` | `Enum.UIDragDetectorResponseStyle.Offset` | read/write | What the detector changes as the object is dragged. |

## Events

Signals are deferred: a handler runs at the next resumption point, not
inside the call that fired the signal.

### `DragContinue(position: Vector2)`

Fires when the pointer moves during a drag.

### `DragEnd(position: Vector2)`

Fires when the drag ends: the press is released, or the object or the detector is removed.

### `DragStart(position: Vector2)`

Fires when a press on the object starts to move it. `position` is the pointer's position, in pixels.
